theme: Landing in Dubrovnik, loose ends before the boat.
greeting: Good morning from the Adriatic, Dan. Today is the last leg down to Dubrovnik, then a few days of Old Port views before the charter takes over on Friday.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat arrivals still open
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat hotel is booked, but the Komolac transfer, the bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout all still need arranging. Sort them from dry land before you board Friday, when connectivity drops.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the sailing charter
needsAttention.detail: Reach the Nautilus instructor to lock Saturday's boarding time and location plus the Sept 19 return transfer. It has been open since the 5th and only gets harder once you are underway.

needsAttention.title: Book the Tampa rental car
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20 to Oct 5 full-size SUV is no longer a hedge. Book it outright so you are not paying walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday landing.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20 to 22 still needs lodging before the Orlando villa, and the Sept 27 to Oct 5 Airbnb was left pending the host. Worth a glance to confirm it converted.

flagged.title: Global public policy exec role
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced an Executive Director, Global Public Policy and Multilateral Engagement posting, squarely in your lane.

flagged.title: Lubrano wants a call
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano at Valoris is still angling for a call on a possible Nomura project; the thread moved on with Chie, but the call sits with you.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel plumbing, Booking.com receipts, gate changes, a nap-pod invoice, plus the usual retail promos.
inbox.clear: Your Croatia bookings are all confirmed: flights, the Dubrovnik apartment, and the Cavtat hotel.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel locked in
resolved.detail: Remisens Hotel Epidaurus confirmed for Sept 19 (Booking.com 5547387205); only the transfers remain.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are at their crisp, tart peak—perfect for baking into something rich.

acts.line: A night in the Frankfurt nap pod behind you, then wheels-up on the last leg south.
Dubrovnik and the Old Port apartment, where the traveling finally eases for a few days.
A quiet Adriatic night before Friday's charter turns the trip active.
